name: 袁隆平
title: 杂交水稻之父
description: 中国研究与发展杂交水稻的开创者，为解决世界粮食安全问题作出重大贡献。
descriptionEn: Pioneer of hybrid rice research in China, made significant contributions to world food security.

quotes.text: 我有两个梦，一个是禾下乘凉梦，一个是杂交水稻覆盖全球梦。
quotes.textEn: I have two dreams: one is to rest under rice stalks taller than sorghum, the other is for hybrid rice to cover the globe.

quotes.text: 人就像种子，要做一粒好种子。
quotes.textEn: People are like seeds. Be a good seed.

quotes.text: 我不在家就在试验田，不在试验田就在去试验田的路上。
quotes.textEn: If I'm not at home, I'm in the experimental field. If I'm not in the experimental field, I'm on my way to the experimental field.

quotes.text: 书本和电脑很重要，但是书本和电脑里种不出水稻来。
quotes.textEn: Books and computers are important, but you can't grow rice in books or computers.

quotes.text: 我毕生的追求就是让所有人远离饥饿。
quotes.textEn: My lifelong pursuit is to free everyone from hunger.

quotes.text: 成功没有捷径。我不在家，就在试验田；不在试验田，就在去试验田的路上。
quotes.textEn: There is no shortcut to success. If I'm not at home, I'm in the experimental field; if I'm not in the experimental field, I'm on my way there.

quotes.text: 科学研究要勇于探索，勇于创新，这个是关键。
quotes.textEn: Scientific research requires the courage to explore and innovate. That is the key.

quotes.text: 我觉得，人就像一粒种子。要做一粒健康的种子，身体、精神、情感都要健康。
quotes.textEn: I think people are like seeds. You must be a healthy seed — healthy in body, mind, and emotion.

quotes.text: 发展杂交水稻，造福世界人民。
quotes.textEn: Develop hybrid rice to benefit the people of the world.

quotes.text: 一粒粮食能救一个国家，也可以绊倒一个国家。
quotes.textEn: A single grain of rice can save a country, or can trip up a country.
